summary: A UI action bus handler (subscribeById, subscribeByType, useAiClientActionById, useAiClientActionByType) that returns false is now reported as rejected-handler instead of ok; UiActionHandler may return boolean.
howTo: Return false (or throw) from a bus handler only when the action did not happen; return nothing or true when it did. A handler that returned false by accident now makes the model read 'declined'. A direct bus.dispatch(...) call rejects with a UiActionRejectedError for such a handler, and dispatchToolResultUiActions rejects: catch it where the call is not awaited.
